Name: Aimon's Mega Four Corners Farm
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[center][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][i][color=#fff2cc]Always run out of space for buildings and all those sweet sweet Cornucopia trees and crops? This map grants should help with it![/color]

[color=#ffe599]Big thanks to  LadyFaeliel (ladyfaeliel - Discord) for commissioning me! All the original layout idea belongs to them. This was a huge project but was really fun to make![/color][/i]

[b]Beware! This map has huge size of 160x130 tiles! (around 150x120 accessible for building and planting). This may be laggy on weak PC setups (means less FPS than usual). [/b][/size]
[/font][/center][font=Comic Sans MS]

[size=3][b][u][color=#ffe599]What this mod adds:[/color][/u][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]A whole new custom farm map (doesn't affect vanilla 4 corners farm)[/size]
[*][size=3]Configurable starter giftbox items! (choose before creating new save file)[/size]
[*][size=3]Little quarry with respawnable ore (configurable)[/size]
[*][size=3]Area with 6 respawnable hardwood stumps (configurable)[/size]
[*][size=3]Prespawned Coop with 2 Chickens (SpaceCore is required for this feature)[/size]
[*][size=3]Blue grass patches (near the coop area)[/size]
[*][size=3]Respawnable forest forage (configurable)[/size]
[*][size=3]Warp system all around the farm [/size]
[*][size=3]Warps to Secret Woods and Grandpha's Shed map (if SVE is installed)[/size]
[*][size=3]Forest and Mountain fish pools in rivers and ponds (forest fish in bottom ponds, mountain - in upper ponds)[/size]
[/list][/size]
[img]https://imgur.com/QoiZHAg.png[/img]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Starter Gift - (will only work if you start fresh game - choose BEFORE creating new save file.)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Starter Giftbox items available: [/size][/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2][spoiler] 
﻿ ﻿- Farming - will give you 15 Parsnip Seeds and 1 Sprinkler
﻿ ﻿- Foraging -  will give you 10 Carrot seeds, 3 Field Snacks and 1 Forager's Hat
﻿ ﻿- Fishing -  will give you 1 CrabPot and 1 Training Rod
﻿ ﻿- Combating -  will give you 1 Wooden Blade and 3 Cherry Bombs
﻿ ﻿- Ranching -  will give you 20 Hay and 3 Cookies
﻿ ﻿- Floristing -  will give you 9 Tulip Seeds, 9 Jazz Seeds and 1 Fedora Hat
﻿ ﻿- Jojaing -  ???  [/spoiler] 
[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Spawn Forage - true/false[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Spawn Stumps - true/false[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Spawn Ore - true/false[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Grass Tiles for Trees - true/false - adds dark grass patches in top left corner.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[img]https://imgur.com/GqZYehL.png[/img]
[size=2][color=#b6d7a8][b]Compatible[/b][/color] with expansions like Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, East Scarpe, ect...
[color=#b6d7a8][b]Compatible [/b][/color]with any recolors and retextures. [/size]

[img]https://imgur.com/lMF7LuG.png[/img]
[/font][list=1]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and all the required tilesheets mods.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Unzip "Aimon's Mega Four Corners Farm" archive into Stardew\Mods folder.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Enjoy.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[/font][center][font=Comic Sans MS][b][color=#ffe599][size=4]Mods used on screenshots:[/size][/color][/b]
[size=3]----------------------------[/size]
[size=3]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/size]
[size=3]VPR Temporary fix 1.6[/size]
[size=3]Wildflower Grass[/size]
[size=3]Simple Foliage[/size]
[size=3]Better Water 2[/size]
[size=3]Visible Fish
Medieval Buildings[/size]
[size=3]Stardew Valley Expanded[/size]
[size=3]----------------------------[/size][/font][/center][font=Comic Sans MS]
